name: Count Up
description: Inline animated number counter that counts from one value to another, or rolls digit columns like an odometer, with prefix, suffix, separators, compact units and optional replay on hover.
contents: A single inline span showing a formatted number with optional prefix and suffix
In roll mode, per-digit vertical strips with motion blur and an offscreen screen reader text
behavior: Starts when scrolled into view once, or on load when trigger is load
Count mode updates the text from start to end value with the chosen easing
Roll mode spins each digit column with staggered timing, blur, and fade for digits that enter or leave
Direction down swaps start and end values
Compact format shortens values to K, M, B, T units
Replays on pointer enter when replayOnHover is true, roll mode spins in place
Skips animation and jumps to the final value when the user prefers reduced motion
editableByProps: Start and end values, direction, delay, duration, easing
Prefix, suffix, thousands separator, decimal places, compact units
Trigger on view or load, gating through startWhen, replay on hover
Font, size and color through className and style

needsCodeEdit.change: Add or change compact unit labels
Change roll cell height or column stagger
Replay every time the element re-enters view

fixed: The prop to is required, there is no default
Requires the motion package, imported from motion/react
Renders an inline span with tabular-nums, it has no frame and does not center itself
Roll mode uses fixed 1.2em cell height and a hidden SVG blur filter per digit column
View trigger fires once only, with no re-trigger on scrolling back
Roll mode digits are aria-hidden with the final value in sr-only text
Reduced motion preference skips the animation
Hover replay needs pointer events, so touch devices only get the initial run
Responsive result: scales with the surrounding font size, no fixed widths, works at all sizes
